title: दुई दिनको उकालो, एक दिनमै उल्टियो

story.audience: Nepali viewers following gold prices, especially household jewellery buyers
story.takeaway: A short rise can reverse; the dated quoted gold rate is not a jewellery bill or a forecast.
hooks: सुनको दुई दिनको वृद्धि, एकै दिनमै मेटियो!
सुन घट्यो, तर गहनाको बिल नि?

sections.text: सुनको दुई दिनको वृद्धि, एकै दिनमै मेटियो!
नेपालमा तेइस र चौबीस नोभेम्बरमा भाउ बढ्दा, तोलामा जम्मा पाँच हजार तीन सय रुपैयाँ थपिएको थियो।
तर पच्चीस नोभेम्बरमा छ हजार पाँच सय रुपैयाँ घटेपछि, दर दुई लाख एकचालीस हजार चार सयमा झर्‍यो। अर्थात्, त्यो वृद्धि मेटिएर भाउ अझ बाह्र सय तल पुग्यो।

तर यो सूचीकृत दर भएकाले, यसैलाई गहनाको बिल नसम्झनुहोस्। किनकि बिलमा सुनको मूल्यसँगै ज्याला र अरू शुल्क जोडिन सक्छन्। बिहेको गहना किन्न बाँकी भएकालाई यो राहत हुन सक्छ, तर पहिल्यै किनिसकेको व्यक्तिलाई चाहिँ यही गिरावटले चिन्ता दिन सक्छ।
यसले सम्झाउँछ—सुरक्षित लगानी भनिए पनि सुनको भाउ घट्न सक्छ, र दुई दिन बढ्दैमा गिरावट सकियो भन्न मिल्दैन।
तपाईं सुन गहनाका लागि किन्नुहुन्छ, कि बचतका लागि?

sources: Rates checked 2026-11-25. Onlinekhabar reports the Federation of Nepal Gold and Silver Dealers' Association's quoted Nepal gold rates; the federation's live website did not expose a directly readable rate in this research environment. Do not describe this as an independently retrieved federation price series.
2026-11-23: Rs 247,400; 2026-11-24: Rs 247,900. The two-day rise was Rs 5,300. https://english.onlinekhabar.com/gold-price-rises-6.html
2026-11-25: Rs 241,400 per tola, down Rs 6,500 from Rs 247,900. https://english.onlinekhabar.com/gold-price-drops-by-rs-6500.html
Derived arithmetic: 247900 - 242600 = 5300; 247900 - 241400 = 6500; 6500 - 5300 = 1200. Distinguish the two-day rise from the latest one-day fall.

All artwork is original vector illustration. Chart plots the four reported daily quotations, not intraday prices. Y-axis is explicitly truncated to Rs 240,000-250,000; connecting segments are guides between reported daily points.

Jewellery bill, wedding buyer, prior buyer, wallet and shield are conceptual illustrations, not reporting on identifiable people, actual shop invoices, guaranteed resale prices or investment returns. Making/other charges depend on the transaction; no amount, tax rate or deduction is asserted.

The reel explains a dated reversal, not its unverified causes or a future price forecast. No buy/sell recommendation. Synthetic Nepali narration; no cloned voice. Original procedural music and two explicitly cued soft effects.

hook.description: A substantial original gold ingot rises and then drops past its starting level; the motion is illustrative, not a price chart.

market.description: A dated four-point chart of reported gold quotations, with a visibly labelled truncated axis and a comparison of the two-day rise and one-day fall.

objects.text: सांकेतिक बिल · वास्तविक शुल्क र बिक्री सर्त फरक हुन्छन्

people.description: Two fictional shoppers respond differently to the same fall: an upcoming wedding purchase and a prior gold purchase. Neither is a prediction or a claim of a realised loss.

objects.text: सांकेतिक पात्र · चिन्ता हुनु र घाटा बेचेर स्वीकार्नु फरक हो

risk.description: An original shield contains a changing gold-price line; the shield does not prevent a downward move, and an unresolved ending avoids forecasting future prices.
